items.title: Mobile-Friendly Responsive Experience
items.reason: Lifecycle contains fewer events than the configured instance-construction minimum.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SMASH ROOM that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
<http://SMASHROOMUSA.com|SMASHROOMUSA.com>

I want the design to be clean, modern, mobile-friendly, and similar in simplicity to iSmashUSA. Black, purple, and white branding with large images, lots of spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Fairfield, CA
San Francisco, CA
Seattle, WA

I want each location to have its own dedicated page while maintaining the same design and branding across all locations.

The website should be built so future locations can easily be added without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Phoenix
Denver
Austin
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

items.title: Location Page Content Structure
items.reason: Lifecycle contains fewer events than the configured instance-construction minimum.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SMASH ROOM brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Seattle should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Seattle Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

The page should be designed so that once Seattle opens, we only need to turn on booking and update photos without redesigning the page.

The Seattle page should become the template for future locations.
